title: Every improvement run kept and shown on the Models page, in an Improvements tab and in the models table with an improvement tag
request: The owner: the improvement (the Experimenter's 'improve the model for me') works fine, but in the Models section we have to see an Improvements tab and store all improvements, and also bring them into the main table of models with a tag of the improvement. With screenshots: the Models page's screen table, and the chat's improvement report saying 2 ways cleared the margin but none can be adopted here ('choose it on the Models page').
spec: The project keeps every run of the Experimenter (improvement_runs, numbered, newest last, the latest 50) beside the latest one (improvements, which the chat and the adoption read). The Models page gets an Improvements tab with a count: every run newest first, the model it tried to improve, each way with its score on the folds, gain, folds better and verdict, and what can be done with it here (Adopt for the latest run's adoptable way that cleared; Choose the family for another family that cleared; cannot be adopted yet for other features and a blend), and a button to run the Experimenter again. The models table lists each way's latest result under the ranked families, tagged 'improvement · run N' with its verdict, never ranked by the declared rule.
plan: Read how the Experimenter stores its run: one improvements record, overwritten by each run
Read the Models page: its panes, the screen table, the override modal
Check whether the chat's 'choose it on the Models page' is true for each kind of way
Keep every run in a numbered history with a fallback for projects improved before
Add the Improvements tab and the table rows; reuse the improve, adopt and override paths
Test the history, the cap, the legacy fallback and the chat's sentence; screenshot both looks

decisions.decision: The history is a second field; the latest run stays in improvements
decisions.why: the chat report, the adoption and the orchestrator read improvements: keeping it unchanged keeps them working

decisions.decision: The table shows each way's latest result, not every run's
decisions.why: two runs on the same model give the same ways; every run is in the Improvements tab, the table stays one row per way

decisions.decision: Improvement rows sit under the ranked families, with no rank and no adjusted score
decisions.why: the declared rule ranked the screen before the run; a way chosen afterwards on the same folds is optimistic and must not look selected

decisions.decision: Adopt only from the latest run
decisions.why: the adoption reads the latest run and its parameters for the current model; an older run's way may belong to a model since replaced

decisions.decision: Choose <family> opens the existing override, preselected
decisions.why: the graph validator checks that move already; the final stage then tunes the family again, so the candidate's own parameters are not carried

decisions.decision: The chat no longer sends features and blends to the Models page
decisions.why: no page can adopt another recipe or a blend yet: the sentence said something untrue

change: dclab_rnd/studio/improve.py (improvement_runs, run numbers, MAX_RUNS, history(), the adoption marks its run, a truthful error); dclab_rnd/jobs/handlers.py (_not_adoptable: where each kind of way can be used); dclab_rnd/agentic/web/src/views/models.html (the Improvements pane, the table's improvement rows, Adopt, Choose, Try again, the override preselected); src/look.css (the rows' styles); tests/test_improve.py (two tests).

findings.defect: Only the latest improvement run was kept
findings.scenario: a person asks to improve the model twice: the first run's ways are gone
findings.cause: improve.run wrote one improvements record per project, replaced by each run
findings.fix: each run also appended to improvement_runs, numbered, the latest 50 kept

findings.defect: The Models page did not show the improvement runs at all
findings.scenario: the chat says to choose a way on the Models page, and the page has no trace of it
findings.cause: the page read the models and final records only
findings.fix: an Improvements tab with every run, and the ways in the models table with an improvement tag
findings.test: screenshots of the tab and the table in both looks; browser checks pages and mobile

findings.defect: The chat said a feature recipe or a blend that cleared could be chosen on the Models page
findings.scenario: two ways cleared (the log_numeric features and a blend): the chat says choose it on the Models page, where nothing can choose them
findings.cause: one sentence for every way that is not adoptable, written before the page existed
findings.fix: the sentence names another family as choosable on the Models page and says other features and a blend cannot be adopted yet

findings.defect: Each improvement row in the table was very tall
findings.scenario: the label, two tags and the gain line wrapped in a narrow first column
findings.cause: two pills side by side were wider than the column
findings.fix: one tag and the verdict as short coloured text, the first column at least 300 px

findings.defect: Choose <family> could preselect the wrong model in the override
findings.scenario: run 1 offers Choose lightgbm; after lightgbm is chosen the button stays, and the modal, which drops the chosen model from its options, silently preselects the first other family
findings.cause: the button compared with the run's model, not the project's chosen one, and the modal ignored a preselection it could not find
findings.fix: the button only for a family that is not the chosen one; the modal refuses a preselection it cannot show, with why

findings.defect: Adopt was offered after the project's model changed, and the next final run would ignore the adoption
findings.scenario: the latest run improved extra_trees; the person then chose lightgbm; Adopt stored extra_trees settings and the final run reread the holdout without them
findings.cause: the page and adopt_candidate did not compare the run's model and features with the project's current ones; the engine uses an adoption only for its own family and recipe
findings.fix: the page offers Adopt only on a run of the current setup; adopt_candidate refuses another model or recipe with why
findings.test: tests/test_improve.py: a run on another family is refused

findings.defect: Runs from an earlier setup were shown in the table as on the same folds
findings.scenario: improve, change the recipe or the data and rerun: the table still shows the earlier run's ways
findings.cause: runs were filtered by metric only
findings.fix: a run is in the table only when its model, recipe, folds and metric are the current ones; in the tab an earlier setup's run is marked and never offered for adoption

findings.defect: Choose <family> did not say the way's own settings are not carried
findings.scenario: the person expects the improvement's score, the final stage tunes the family again on its own candidates
findings.cause: nothing said it, in the modal or the chat
findings.fix: one sentence in the modal when opened from an improvement and in the chat's sentence

findings.defect: An adoption during a run could lose a run or its mark
findings.scenario: Adopt clicked while an improvement runs: one of the two whole-document writes overwrites the other
findings.cause: the run reads its history and writes later; the adoption saves the whole document
findings.fix: Adopt hidden while a run goes on, and refused by adopt_candidate while running is improve

findings.defect: The adoption marking was never exercised by the test
findings.scenario: the small table never made a way that cleared and was adoptable, so the branch was skipped
findings.cause: the test relied on the data producing a winner
findings.fix: a cleared adoptable way written into the latest run, adopted, the marks asserted [None, id]

findings.defect: Fifty whole runs make the project document large
findings.scenario: about 5 KB per run, rewritten on every save and polled every 3 s while a run goes on
findings.cause: each run kept its per-fold lists
findings.fix: runs older than the latest five keep means, gains and verdicts, without the per-fold lists
findings.test: tests/test_improve.py: an older run has no fold_scores

findings.defect: Try again said the run appears when done, but the page did not refresh, and a refusal was said only in the draft's chat
findings.scenario: the button is pressed, the job starts after the page's reload, no poll starts; a project without a draft never hears a refusal
findings.cause: the poll depended on running being set already; the refusal was not logged on the project
findings.fix: the page polls until a new run is kept or a refusal is logged on the project, which it shows
findings.test: browser: Try again shows Improving and then run 3 without a reload

measurements.name: a local churn project improved twice through the API, the Models page in both looks
measurements.gate: both runs in the tab, its count 2, the ways in the table, no console error
measurements.result: 2 runs listed newest first, count 2, 7 ways in the table tagged run 2, no error in either look
limits: headless Chromium in a cloud sandbox
no way of another family cleared on this table, so the Choose button was not seen on a page

measurements.name: Try again on the Models page, Data science look
measurements.gate: the new run appears without a reload
measurements.result: the button said Improving and was disabled; run 3 appeared and the count went to 3 with no page error
limits: one local project, a run of about a minute

outcome: Every improvement run is kept on the project and shown in the Models page's Improvements tab, and each way's latest result is in the models table with an improvement tag and its verdict, never ranked by the rule. The chat now says truthfully where a way can be used.
lessons: Before adding a history, keep the latest record where its readers read it
A link in a report ('choose it on the Models page') is a promise: check that the page can do it for every case the sentence covers
A result chosen after the rule ran sits beside the ranked ones, never among them
A button that acts on a record must check the record still describes the project's current state, on the page and on the server
risks: Other features and a blend that clear the margin still cannot be adopted anywhere
Choosing another family from an improvement re-runs the final stage with its own tuning, not the candidate's parameters
The held-back cases are read again by any final run after an adoption, which needs a written reason
Two writes to a project can still race outside the improvement run and the adoption: the project store has no read-change-save under one lock
